description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Extension' class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class provides methods for retrieving extension and setting information from a database.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: A model class that handles retrieval of extension-related data from the database, such as listing extensions, filtering by type, and obtaining details through codes.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all extension types from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extensions filtered by a specified type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Fetches detailed extension information based on type and code identifiers.
